detail.longDescription: I just launched the public beta of PaddleBoard, an open-source AI IDE built on Zed. Local models with no API key, a microVM sandbox for whatever the agent runs, and zero telemetry. GPL-3.0. Kick the tires and tell me what breaks: https:// paddleboard.dev I also wrote up the worst bugs from keeping a 280-crate fork alive: https:// paddleboard.dev/blog/worst-bug s-in-a-fork/ # AgenticAI # rustlang # OpenSource
